feature_brief.title: Normalize Text
feature_brief.outcome: One local file yields normalized text or an evidenced deterministic error.
scope_in: Normalize exactly one local UTF-8 file using Python standard library only.
Strip ASCII spaces and tabs at each line edge; preserve interior whitespace and all logical blank lines including trailing blank lines.
Convert CRLF and CR to LF; empty input yields empty output; nonempty normalized output gets a terminating LF only when absent; preserve existing trailing LFs and Unicode.
Write normalized UTF-8 to stdout; invalid UTF-8, missing files, and directories exit 2 with concise stderr and no stdout.

evidence.setup_provenance: Synthetic equivalent pristine active target; does not establish a successful SelectFeature run.
